title: P.C. 369
overview: P.C. 369 is a 1987 Indian Malayalam film, directed by P Chandrakumar. The film stars Suresh Gopi, Mukesh, Rohini and Maniyanpilla Raju in lead roles. The film had musical score by KPN Pillai.
